resources.string: Requires Wear OS 4 or newer. Apple Watch, Garmin, Amazfit, Huawei and Tizen are not supported.
Open watch face in Google Play
Pair your watch with its manufacturer’s phone app. Use the same Google account on both devices.
Open Google Play on your watch. Find TAG Heuer McLaren 30th and install it. A phone install does not install the watch face.
Long-press your current watch face, tap Add, select this face. Use Edit to choose an accent color.
Missing face? Check Wear OS version, Google account and watch installation. Restart the watch. The store link works after publication.
No accounts, advertising, analytics or personal data collection. Store purchases are managed by Google Play.
Independent project. TAG Heuer and McLaren are trademarks of their owners. Commercial branding requires authorization.
